summary: Independent adversarial review found no blocker or important issues; minor findings only.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer agent without producer transcript; evidence limited to scratchpad/PXD023708, spec, installed templates and ontology caches; no network

spec_compliance.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t human -t clinical-metadata --use_ols_cache_only (serialized with flock) exit 0, no errors; only warnings are the 4 free-text characteristics[phenotype] labels. 70 rows x 37 columns, uniform row width, no blank cells, no leading/trailing whitespace, LF endings, ASCII. Template declarations (ms-proteomics v1.1.0, human v1.1.0, clinical-metadata v1.0.0) match installed templates.yaml latest versions. Reserved words (not available for age/sex, not applicable for cell type and pooled-QC disease) are permitted by TERMS.tsv. sdrf-tools structure OK.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Resolved against local parquet caches one file at a time: MS:1002877 q exactive hf-x, MS:1001251 trypsin, MS:1000422 beam-type collision-induced dissociation (spec-canonical HCD), PRIDE:0000608 dithiothreitol (dtt), PRIDE:0000599 iodoacetamide (iaa), PRIDE:0000627 data-dependent acquisition, PRIDE:0000450 data-independent acquisition, UNIMOD:4 Carbamidomethyl, UNIMOD:35 Oxidation, UNIMOD:1 Acetyl, UNIMOD:7 Deamidated, UNIMOD:27 Glu->pyro-Glu; label-only values resolve: synovial fluid UBERON:0001090, osteoarthritis, knee MONDO:0005416/EFO:0004616, normal PATO:0000461, Homo sapiens NCBITaxon:9606. sdrf-tools check --offline CLEAN (0 hallucinated, 0 label mismatches, 0 UNIMOD swaps).

source_evidence.evidence: Checked against scratchpad/PXD023708/pride.json (accession PXD023708 confirmed), manuscript.txt (PMC8941261, title matches), files_compact.json and evidence/raw_header_check.json. Cohort n=11 late (arthroplasty), 7 early (arthroscopy, degenerative meniscal tear), 13 deceased-donor controls matches 11 distinct L*, 7 B*, 13 G* subject codes (G2 normalized to G02, which also appears as G02); count-based mapping is the unique consistent assignment and is disclosed as inference. MARS Hu7 depletion, DTT/IAA, trypsin, Q Exactive HF-X, NCE 27, and all modifications (deamidation, Glu->pyro-Glu, Met ox, hydroxyproline=Oxidation P, acetylation) are stated in PRIDE/Methods. Age/sex only as cohort summaries -> not available is correct. Pooled QC 'every 10th sample' quoted verbatim in manuscript. reconcile BLOCKER on 190411_DDA_B414_nr2b refuted: header method is the DIA .meth, RAW size 3.62 GB is within DIA range (all 65 DDA-method RAWs <= 2.15 GB), and the deposit contains 190411_DDA_B414_nr2b.htrms while every other .htrms is a DIA-named run. reconcile MAJOR disease flag is a false positive (controls = normal).

file_mapping.evidence: 70 rows, 70 unique comment[data file]; assay name == data file stem for every row. Exactly the 70 RAWs whose header names the DIA method (69 DIA_-named + 190411_DDA_B414_nr2b.raw); together with the -dda split covers all 135 deposited RAWs with no overlap. Per-row acquisition method matches the RAW-header .meth for all rows (0 mismatches; DDA_QC2b_JM/DDA_test_QC1 -> DDA, DIA_STD_120kMS1_45kMS2_24VarWin -> DIA), including 190411_DDA_B414_nr2b.raw = DIA and 190326_pooled_SF* = DDA.

design_consistency.evidence: 33 sources / 32 individuals (L441 has nr1 and nr2 DIA sources; B414_nr2b maps to source B414_nr2). Every row is identical to its combined-file row except comment[technical replicate] (43 rows renumbered); technical replicates unique per source and contiguous 1..n in acquisition order (pooled_SF 1..14). Groups: control 20, early 15, late 21, pooled 14; each of the 31 subjects has at least one DIA run.

omission_safety.evidence: No value asserts more than the evidence supports: age/sex left not available, cell type not applicable, acetyl site assumption and B/G/L group inference disclosed in report/manifest limitations; truncated/empty runs (190319_DIA_L441_nr1 230 KB, 190401_DIA_pooled_SF_10 0.24 GB) are deposited files and disclosed. Every cited manifest source exists in scratchpad/PXD023708 (pride.json, files_compact.json/files_raw_names.json, manuscript.txt, evidence/raw_header_check.json) and quotes were found verbatim. Report statements verified: 135x37, 46 sources, group row counts 45/28/42/20, 65 DDA/70 DIA split sizes, 20 _rep2 pairs vs paper's 18, sha256 of combined file.

deterministic_validation.evidence: validate-sdrf exit 0 (warnings only); sdrf-tools structure OK; check --offline CLEAN; score 95/100; reconcile: 1 BLOCKER on 190411_DDA_B414_nr2b refuted by header method, file size and deposited .htrms.

findings.location: pooled_SF rows: characteristics[biological replicate], characteristics[age], characteristics[sex]
findings.message: Pooled QC rows carry biological replicate=1 and age/sex='not available' instead of 'pooled'.
findings.evidence: spec README 'Pooled samples' TIP: use 'pooled' for individual-specific fields (biological replicate, age, sex); TERMS.tsv allow_pooled=true for these columns. Correction: set these three cells to 'pooled' on pooled_SF rows.

findings.message: The report says remaining reconcile flags are 'explained below' but lists only the disease flag; the reconcile BLOCKER acquisition_contradicted_by_run_name on 190411_DDA_B414_nr2b is only implicitly addressed in Key evidence.
findings.evidence: sdrf-tools reconcile output for combined and -dia files. Correction: list the flag explicitly and cite the corroborating 3.62 GB size and deposited 190411_DDA_B414_nr2b.htrms.

findings.message: DIA runs are not declared under the dia-acquisition experiment template and its recommended columns (scan window 350/1650 m/z, variable isolation window) are absent.
findings.evidence: TEMPLATES.adoc 'By Technology': DIA -> dia-acquisition. However the installed dia-acquisition 1.1.0 values validator rejects the NT=...;AC=PRIDE:0000450 form (validated: 'Invalid value ... must be one of the allowed values'), and repo DIA splits (PXD029805, PXD029821) follow the same 3-template convention, so this is not blocking.

findings.location: comment[cleavage agent details]; comment[modification parameters] Acetyl
findings.message: Search used Trypsin/P (MS:1001313) per PRIDE/Methods while SDRF records Trypsin (MS:1001251); Acetyl PP=Protein N-term is an assumed Spectronaut default.
findings.evidence: Wet-lab enzyme trypsin is defensible; the acetyl assumption is disclosed. Optionally note Trypsin/P search rule in the report.
